title: simplify: remove duplicate helper, dead code, and redundant comments in data plane certificate planners
body:
- [x] Remove `stringPointerValue` from `control_plane_data_plane_certificate_planner.go`, replacing with `getString`
- [x] Simplify `shouldUpdateDataPlaneCertificate` in `event_gateway_data_plane_certificate_planner.go` using `getString`
- [x] Fix non-convergence bug: only compare name/description when desired value is non-nil (aligns comparison with update-map logic)
- [x] Remove redundant log in `planDataPlaneCertificateCreatesForNewGateway`
- [x] Remove dead-code nil branch in `MapUpdateFields` in `event_gateway_data_plane_certificate_adapter.go`
- [x] Remove redundant inline comments in `Create`, `Update`, `Delete`, `GetByID`
- [x] Build succeeds, tests pass, CodeQL clean
